statement: At pinned Dolphin revision 8d2ad1a, WiimoteEmu.h defines EEPROM_FREE_SIZE as 0x1700 bytes for its emulated Bluetooth-visible EEPROM region (line 188), and EmuSubroutines.cpp rejects writes only if address + size > EEPROM_FREE_SIZE (line 280). Thus its one-byte write at offset 0x16FF passes the range check, unlike the historical rnconrad emulator. This is a concrete software-implementation disagreement, not retail size or protection evidence.

applicability.revision: Historical independent software emulators, not physical hardware revisions
applicability.scope: Header lines 183-188 and EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 253-289. Contradicts rnconrad's exclusive 0x16FF end check for boundary access; wii-memory-size-hypothesis remains unknown.
